about.title: What is Geo Builder?
about.lead: An intuitive tool for building geometry diagrams — describe a construction in plain language and watch the figure build, step by step.
points: For high-school students preparing for the geometry matriculation (bagrut), and for teachers who need to sketch a figure quickly and simply.
Add one fact at a time — the figure adapts as the givens accumulate.
It draws the figure from what you describe — it does not solve problems.
about.tryTitle: Enter the given data exactly as it appears in the question:

input.placeholder: Type a fact, e.g. "square ABCD" or "point G on AD"
input.notUnderstood: I couldn't read that yet — try one of the examples below.
input.producedNothing: I understood that but it didn't build anything on the figure — I tried rephrasing it too. Check the names/relations, or word it differently.
input.rename_target-taken: {{to}} is already a point — pick a free letter, or swap them (click the segment → Swap endpoints, or type "swap {{from}} and {{to}}").
input.swap_no-source: To swap, both {{from}} and {{to}} must already exist.
input.merge_no-target: There's no point {{to}} to merge into — both points must already exist (use "rename" to relabel).
input.merge_source-in-shape: {{from}} is a shape vertex and can't be folded — edit the shape instead.
input.insertGreek: Insert a Greek letter (an angle variable, e.g. 2α)
input.insertSymbol: Insert a symbol (root/power for a symbolic length, or ∠ ° ⊥ ∥)

examples.heading: Examples — click to try, or type your own

help.title: Commands
guidePoints: Type one fact at a time (e.g. "square ABCD", then "point G on AD"). The figure updates immediately.
Click a point, segment or circle on the figure to rename, hide, or swap endpoints.
"Show another configuration" — shows a different valid drawing of the same construction, when several exist.
"Undo" / "Clear all" — step back or start over.
Download or copy the figure as an image from the buttons above the figure.
Couldn't understand it? Reword it, or use the "Commands" tab.

figure.mismatch: The figure may not match what you described:
figure.pending: This relation is recorded but not determined yet — add the remaining givens (lengths/angles) to pin the figure, and it will resolve on its own.
figure.converge: {{a}} and {{b}} have landed at the same point.
